title: Tea, iced, brewed, black, decaffeinated, pre-sweetened with sugar

content.title: About
content.content: This product is a ready‑to‑drink iced tea made from black tea that has been decaffeinated and sweetened with sugar. It comes in convenient packaging and requires no further preparation.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Black tea is rich in polyphenols, which have antioxidant properties.
Decaffeination preserves most flavor notes while removing almost all caffeine.
Sweetening with sugar makes the beverage sweeter and raises its calorie count.
Iced tea is a popular refreshing drink during the summer months.
Cold‑brew technology can reduce the bitterness typical of hot‑brewed tea.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Black tea provides flavonoids that help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The drink contributes to maintaining the body’s fluid balance, especially in warm weather.

items.title: Stress reduction
items.content: Theanine present in tea may promote relaxation without causing drowsiness.

items.title: Digestive support
items.content: Both warm and cold teas can aid normal gastrointestinal function.

items.title: Energy support
items.content: Although caffeine is removed, other bioactive compounds can give a mild boost in alertness.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Added sugar can raise blood glucose levels and increase the beverage’s caloric load.

items.title: Tea allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to tea components.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Tea may increase stomach acidity, which can be problematic for people with gastritis or reflux.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the iced tea straight from the package or pour it over ice in a glass. For extra flavor, add a slice of lemon or a sprig of mint.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 3–5 days.
